episodes.synopsis: The three Kumoh brothers ferry criminals to the largest prison in Japan, Gokumonjo. One day, a criminal escapes en route to the prison…
episodes.title: Three Brothers, Standing Under the Clouds

episodes.synopsis: The day after the incident with the escaped criminal, Tenka heads to the clinic where he finds out that a murderer is heading toward Kumoh Shrine.
episodes.title: Cutthroat, Sneering at the Clouds

episodes.synopsis: Soramaru wants to be stronger so Tenka can rely on him, so he asks Sosei to train him. But Soramaru has to prove his worth first…
episodes.title: Second Son, Undercover in Prison

episodes.synopsis: Soramaru meets a mysterious masked man in Gokumonjo and regains memories of the past. Meanwhile, Shirasu is on his way to rescue him…
episodes.title: Fuma, Sneaking Through the Prison Gate

episodes.synopsis: Soramaru brings the information from Gokumonjo to the Yamainu to try to make a deal with them while Tenka is home sick…
episodes.title: Tenka, Shaken by Turmoil

episodes.synopsis: Soramaru and Chutaro discover the relationship between the Orochi and the Kumoh family and learn of the burden Tenka was carrying by himself…
episodes.title: The Sun, Disappearing into the Clouds

episodes.synopsis: Six hundred years ago, Abe no Hirari met Botan and the predecessors of the Kumoh and Sasaki families and battled the Orochi of the Kamakura period…
episodes.title: Fleeting Laughter

episodes.synopsis: The sun hides behind rainclouds as those Tenka left behind try to come to terms with his execution and continue on with their lives…
episodes.title: Boys, Lamenting in the Rain

episodes.synopsis: While Kagami talks to Chutaro, Sosei investigates Gokumonjo. Meanwhile, Soramaru has been having trouble sleeping...
episodes.title: Successor, Standing Under the Murky Sky

episodes.synopsis: Shirasu makes his true intentions known, and Soramaru faces what lies within him as Chutaro continues his journey with Kagami…
episodes.title: White Darkness, Turning Back

episodes.synopsis: Tenka has reappeared, but he learns that his brothers are in trouble and goes after them. Meanwhile, the Yamainu go after the Orochi…
episodes.title: The Sun, Shining Again in the Clouds

episodes.synopsis: The Kumoh brothers are finally reunited for the final battle against the Orochi and the Fuma…
episodes.title: Brothers, Gathering Under the Sun
